_comment: The AtomWorks Studio release this site is built from. tools/build-studio.mjs downloads the bundle, checks it against sha256 and composes index.html from it. Nothing from Studio is vendored in this repository.
_override: While `override` is set, assets/ and index.html are built from that unreleased Studio commit, not the release below: `npm run build:studio` refuses to run, and the site is rebuilt with `npm run build:studio -- --from <bundle built from override.commit>` (packages/web: pnpm install && pnpm build, then --from packages/web/dist). Remove `override` once a release contains the change, then build normally.

override.why: setOverlay({ representation: 'cartoon' }) for the refold overlay (cf8aa98, RosettaCommons/atomworks-studio#29), live frames drawn as cartoon plus ligands (c1e30a8), setHighlight for hotspots (51fe162), and Show/Hide sequence in the viewer toolbar with no dock heading (c8dad76), and setSelection, so the design panel's residue strip selects in the viewer and sequence (a4a2ea9), and residue picking by default with a clicked residue shown alone (d7e72bb), sticks following the selection (7505dee), and closeDocument, so Clear empties the viewer and sequence (204725a), and a chain palette in cool colours only, so hotspots (amber) and the refold (magenta) are never a chain's colour (63a4745), and setHighlight with a transparency, so residues the model rebuilds are faded in the input (f7a02ee), and centerOn, so a piece's residues are brought to the middle of the view when its popup opens (12c2b78), and selection drawn as an outline in the text colour with no tint, in the viewer and the sequence bar, so chain colours and hotspots show through (912934c), and a run of selected residues in the sequence bar drawn as one box (c8d0b8c), and whole residues selected outlined on the cartoon with no sticks, atoms picked keeping their residues' sticks (c17a919), and highlights repainted on every live frame, so hotspots stay on their residues while designed residues change (d367afb), and setTheme, so the page's light mode switches Studio's colours and the viewer's background with it (1223070), and the viewer starting on the page's background, so a light page does not flash black while it loads (eb6a62e), and Mol*'s light skin under a light theme, so its menus follow the page (b600b6c), and the empty viewer's text in the theme's colours (8fc0ac7), and a cartoon overlay's sizeFactor, so the chain as loaded is drawn faint and a little thinner behind an edit of it (acd7a46), and one set of trajectory controls, Studio's bar, with Mol*'s model stepper and animation button hidden and the camera fitted to the design rather than the first frame (ceb0403), and highlights that take a residue's insertion code, so a hotspot on an antibody's H82 no longer paints H82A, H82B and H82C (a1471fb)
